location_exception_reason: Control Panel Cabins are industrial prefabricated structures sold nationwide by specification (material, insulation, IP rating, internal fittings); location of manufacture or seller headquarters does not change the product's functional identity or buyer decision criteria. Regional origin is not a GI-tagged or origin-defined product attribute.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Fabricator, Dealer) in titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title like 'Control Panel Cabin Manufacturer' leaves a complete product description; the cabin itself is the product, not the business relationship.
